profile.headline: Software Engineer at Frontier Communications
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with over 20 years of experience working across testing, development, and data-driven systems in complex production environments.

I started my career in QA and test engineering, and that foundation continues to shape how I approach software today. I have a deep understanding of how systems fail across UI, API, database, and service layers, and I use that perspective to design, debug, and improve systems that are reliable, scalable, and production-ready.

Over time, I transitioned into development and data-focused engineering roles, where I now work on large-scale systems involving data pipelines, serviceability platforms, and search/indexing systems. My work centers on improving data accuracy, system reliability, and performance across interconnected systems that directly impact customer experience and business outcomes.

I’m often brought in to diagnose complex, high-visibility issues; connecting the dots across multiple systems, identifying root causes, and implementing durable fixes rather than surface-level patches. I’m comfortable working in ambiguity, quickly ramping on unfamiliar systems, and bringing structure to problems that don’t have obvious solutions.

Core strengths:
• Root Cause Analysis across distributed systems (UI, API, DB, services)  
• Data Engineering and System Integration (SQL Server, DB2, Databricks)  
• Data Quality, Normalization, and Large-scale Reconciliation  
• API and Microservice Reliability  
• Performance Optimization and Production Stability  
• Test Strategy and Automation (Selenium, API testing, integration testing)

Technical stack:
• SQL (advanced), Python, C#, T-SQL  
• Databricks, Azure DevOps, Elasticsearch/Kibana  
• API integration, automation frameworks, and distributed systems  

Earlier in my career, I contributed to Microsoft System Center releases, Xbox titles, and enterprise web services, developing a strong appreciation for quality, performance, and user experience at scale.

I focus on building systems that work correctly in the real world, not just in ideal conditions, and continuously look for ways to improve reliability, efficiency, and engineering effectiveness.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description: Skills: Data Engineering · Databricks (SQL Warehouse, Notebooks, Apps) · API Development · Azure DevOps Services · Geocoding

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Own the design process, implementation, and verification of framework components leveraging standard software engineering methodologies

• Knowledge and experience of complex software design for distributed systems in embedded networking/telecommunications projects.

positions.title: QA Test Analyst III (SDET)
positions.description:
•	Design automated UI & API test scenarios to ensure test coverage on the priority-one use cases during nightly CI/CD
•	Implement automated UI & API test scenarios using Selenium WebDriver / C#.NET / various other tech as needed
•	Ensure the stability / reliability of test automation thru frequent CI/CD defect investigations, code reviews and test code fixes. 
•	Manual testing on multiple internal apps as well as apps supporting Customer Service and cross-business teams
•	Code reviews of app code changes, resulting in many defects being found and code changes before deployment
•	Conduct official pre-deployment test passes and provide QA sign-off for deployment to PROD
•	Weekly Audit of deployment deliverables
•	Participate in regular tech debt and dev standards meetings to guide the future of our technology assets

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Meet with internal teams and product owners to discuss internal tools requirements during story planning
•	Interpret written requirements or technical specifications in the stories assigned to me 
•	Design and implement new features according to the requirements written by product owners using C#.NET, ASP.NET and SQL
•	Create unit tests for new and existing projects to ensure important functions are working as expected
•	Regularly perform code reviews on my teammate’s code as well as submit my own changes for review
•	Run root cause analysis on issues reported by internal teams and implement changes to correct defects
•	Create reports for internal teams and other departments using T-SQL queries of production data

positions.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Identify and drive both manual and automated test strategies for API, UI and Database testing of the DocuTrack product.
•	Implemented new automated test scripts and enhanced existing ones using WScript and WinAutomation.
•	Daily SCRUM participation for standups, backlog management and daily burndown. 
•	Contribute to DocuTrack product knowledge base used by Dev, QA and Support.
•	Create and maintain reusable test data for various manual/automated test cases.

positions.title: SDET
positions.description:
System Center Team
•	Utilized both Waterfall and Agile SCRUM software development methods in different teams.
•	Write new test automation code to increase test coverage for new features in SCOM.
•	Self-driven organization and test planning to create new test strategies for SCOM products during each release cycle.
•	Utilize a combination of C#, MAUI, MCF and open source for test automation.

Azure Team
•	Drive testing for each Sprint toward concrete goals, despite product ambiguity.
•	Ensure availability of TaaS service internally created and hosted in Windows Azure.
•	Refactor old code in the Azure Billing feature to be reliable, reusable and modular.
•	Write new billing test cases for Azure in C#.NET & JS using MSTest+TFS+Test Manager.

Key Contributions
•	Recognized across my group for both customer advocacy and expanding automation coverage.
•	Contributed to design and implementation of our Test as a Service (TaaS) Azure web service.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer Level 5 [Excell CSG]
positions.description:
•	Test owner of several SCOM improvements to plan and execute test strategies.
•	Utilize a combination of C#.NET and MS internal test automation frameworks.
•	Develop reusable automated tests for UI & API testing on SCOM Desktop and Web Console.
•	Investigate UI test automation faults & determine whether it was a product/test code defect.
•	Fix test code bugs if I am owner or assign to actual owner for fix.
•	Guide PM/Dev/Test team members to ensure highest test coverage w/low overlap testing.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer 4 [Excell CSG]
positions.description:
System Center Operations Manager 2007 - Microsoft
•	Drive multiple System Center Operations Manager (SCOM) improvements simultaneously.
•	Kick off automated test passes & investigate BVT/FUNC failures.
•	Develop fixes for test code bugs in automated UI tests for ENU and Glob/Loc builds.
•	Coordinate test strategies for SCOM Cumulative Update releases (CU) with PM/Dev/Test.
•	Ensure product stability 9 Localized versions of SCOM tested using matching localized OS.
•	Escalate critical issues to the appropriate Dev or Test owner, as necessary.

positions.title: QA Test Lead
positions.description:
QA Test Lead for Multiplayer games and solutions for Oberon Media and Oberon Games - before they changed their name to I-Play
•	Manage a team of 3 testers, regularly assess strengths/weaknesses and give feedback.
•	Coordinate Multiplayer Casual Games for the Web/PC for both domestic & overseas teams.
•	Develop new test cases, templates and internal Test documentation in new QA team.
•	Liaise between in-house Developers and my direct reports to complete test cycles.
•	Contribute to the shared knowledge base thru wikis and documentation.

positions.title: Test Associate 3 - Lead [Volt CSG]
positions.description:
Tested and Shipped the Xbox 360 game "Perfect Dark Zero"
•	Regarded as TCR expert on Xbox/Xbox 360 titles.
•	Create test plans, matrices, UI flow charts and other internal documents.
•	Report bugs that violate core Xbox requirements and use Visual Studio to debug exceptions.
•	Credited Tester on “Perfect Dark Zero”

positions.title: Test Associate 3 [Volt CSG]
positions.description:
Tested and Shipped the Xbox game "Conker: Live and Reloaded"
•	Regarded as TCR expert on Xbox/Xbox 360 titles.
•	Create test plans, matrices, UI flow charts and other internal documents.
•	Report bugs that violate core Xbox requirements and use Visual Studio to debug exceptions.
•	Credited Tester on Rareware games “Conker: Live & Reloaded”

positions.title: Compliance QA Test Engineer 1 [Volt CSG]
positions.description:
Operate under tight deadlines and efficiently execute test cases in the time frame required.
Edit any errors made by other testers on my team and ensure accuracy of my area in the bug reporting database.
Analyze, report and troubleshoot software errors found while testing.
Responsible for coordination of large scale tasks and distribution of test cases amongst team members, as well as other teams.
Escalate major issues to the attention of my lead.

positions.title: Functional QA Tester / Lead - [Volt CSG]
positions.description:
Manage a team of 7 testers.
Edit and convert tester's hand-written bugs into electronic form to submit to the Client daily.
Organize the team so proper execution of the Client-provided test plan occurs.
Create matrices to balance testing of each software title.
Track internal data as required by Management.
Ensure testers are continuously using the tools provided to capture bugs in order to adequately produce them later.
